Diagnostic frida-java-bridge derivative

Project: https://github.com/frida/frida-java-bridge
Original artifact: bridges/java.js bundled with installed frida-tools 14.10.4.
The original bytes are retained in frida-java-bridge-original.js.

Only the changes from upstream commit
302a588881b40cba300bcf3acfd35deeb3888ee5 (android: Fix ART crash on Android 17 arm64)
are reproduced in frida-java-bridge-302a588.js. Upstream author: Wes765;
committer: oleavr. This is a locally modified diagnostic artifact, not an
official upstream binary release. No other compatibility fixes are implied.

Upstream commit:
https://github.com/frida/frida-java-bridge/commit/302a588881b40cba300bcf3acfd35deeb3888ee5

The upstream package.json at that commit declares:
LGPL-2.0 WITH WxWindows-exception-3.1
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/frida/frida-java-bridge/302a588881b40cba300bcf3acfd35deeb3888ee5/package.json

COPYING.frida-tools is an unchanged copy of the license included with the
installed distribution supplying this bundled artifact. No standalone bridge
LICENSE file was located at the referenced upstream commit; the package.json
license declaration is recorded rather than inventing a copyright notice.

bridge-provenance.json records original/output/license SHA-256 hashes and all
exact substitutions. patch_bridge.py verifies the original hash, checks every
target fragment occurs once, and reverse-checks the changes before writing.
Reproduction requires the exact original bundled artifact; unknown inputs fail.

COPYING.LIB contains the GNU Library General Public License version 2, from
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.0.txt
